# Schema reference — neode v1.0.0-next.1

<!-- generated by pnpm docs:agents — do not edit by hand -->

Package version: **1.0.0-next.1** (from package.json).

> Check these docs, not training data: the package is pre-1.0 and its API
> churns between versions — LLM training corpora mix neode v1, neode and
> unrelated OGMs. Regenerate with `pnpm docs:agents`.

> **Default to decorators (NTS-583).** When creating a new project or new models, define them as
> decorated classes (`@NodeEntity()` + `@Property(...)`) using standard TC39 decorators — never
> `experimentalDecorators`, `emitDecoratorMetadata` or `reflect-metadata`. Use `defineModel` (the
> map API) only when the user asks for it, or decorators are impossible (models built at runtime,
> or a toolchain without standard TC39 decorator support).
>
> Tooling: TypeScript 5+ (or esbuild/SWC/tsdown with standard decorators), `target` ES2022 or later,
> `"lib": ["ES2022", "ESNext.Decorators"]`, and leave `experimentalDecorators` unset.

Neo4j limits: uniqueness constraints are single-property — node key constraints are the Enterprise composite analogue (NTS-650). |

| `createdAt`       | `boolean` (optional)         | Server-side timestamp (NTS-165): stamped with `datetime()` once on create — the map-API form of `@CreatedAt`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `updatedAt`       | `boolean` (optional)         | Server-side timestamp (NTS-165): stamped with `datetime()` on create and on every write — the map-API form of `@UpdatedAt`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `timestampFormat` | `TimestampFormat` (optional) | Stamp form for a server-side timestamp (NTS-612): 'iso-string' renders the stamp as `toString(datetime())` so the stored value compares lexically against client ISO strings; the default stores the temporal — the map-API form of the `@CreatedAt` / `@UpdatedAt` config option.                                                              |
| `version`         | `boolean` (optional)         | Optimistic locking (NTS-158): the integer property every write keeps in sync — stamped 0 on create, incremented by 1 on every write addressed to the node, and checked with `WHERE n.version = $expected` when the instance carries the version it was hydrated with (a mismatch throws `OptimisticLockError`). The map-API form of `@Version`. |

| `hidden`          | `boolean` (optional)         |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |

| `exists`          | `boolean` (optional)         |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `typed`           | `boolean` (optional)         | Opt in to a property-type constraint generated from the declared type (NTS-141): `REQUIRE n.prop IS :: STRING`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `vector`          | `VectorConfig` (optional)    | Declare a vector index over the property (NTS-447): created by `installSchema()` with the deterministic `vectorIndexName()` naming and dropped by `dropSchema()`.                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `derived`         | `DerivedConfig` (optional)   | Stored derived property (NTS-569): computed on the write path from the `from` source properties and stored like a hand-set value. See DerivedConfig — exactly one of `compute` / `cypher`.                                                                                                                                                      |
| `transform`       | `TransformConfig` (optional) | Property value transforms (NTS-449): `in` converts the user value into its stored form before validation on every write path (create / update / merge / bulk writes), `out` converts the stored form back at hydration on read. See TransformConfig.                                                                                            |
| `coalesce`        | `string                      | string[]` (optional)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | Read-side fallbacks applied at hydration when the stored/projected value is null or absent (NTS-139, the Zod `.catch()` analogue): a literal, or sibling property names whose first non-null value wins.                                                                                                              |
| `fake`            | `() => unknown` (optional)   | Per-property fake data generator (NTS-444): user-supplied, no faker dependency. Invoked by factory seeding (and the create path) when neither an explicit value nor `default` applies — precedence on create is explicit value > `default` > `fake`, and generated values are validated like any other write.                                   |

### RelationshipDefinition

| Field          | Type                                 | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| -------------- | ------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `type`         | `'relationship'                      | 'relationships'                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | 'node'                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | 'nodes'`                                              |     |
| `description`  | `string` (optional)                  | Free-text explanation of the relationship for LLM-agent-facing ontology emission (NTS-445): surfaced by `ontology()` / `ontologyMarkdown()`.                                                                                                                                         |
| `relationship` | `string`                             | Neo4j relationship type, e.g. 'KNOWS'                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `direction`    | `string`                             | 'in'                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | 'out'                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | 'both' (case-insensitive, invalid falls back to both) |
| `target`       | `string`                             | Name of the model this relationship points at                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `properties`   | `Record<string, PropertyTypeName     | PropertyDefinition>` (optional)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | The edge-property schema (NTS-628): the allowed edge properties and their types — runtime edge props on relate() / nested creates / updateEdgeProperties validate against it (unknown property or wrong type throws naming the key). Per-property defaults/transforms on edges are a follow-up. |
| `eager`        | `boolean` (optional)                 |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `cascade`      | `boolean` (optional)                 | Per-relationship cascade: deleting a node also deletes the nodes reached through this relationship, recursively (each level applies its own annotations). Unannotated relationships survive unless the delete call opts in with `{ cascade: true }`.                                 |
| `cardinality`  | `RelationshipCardinality` (optional) | Write-time cardinality (NTS-161): 'one' / 'zeroOrOne' allow at most one edge from a node — a second relate() throws CardinalityViolationError; 'many' is unrestricted. Undefined derives from the type: 'relationship' / 'node' declare one, 'relationships' / 'nodes' declare many. |
